about.hero_title: Real estate the way it always should have been.
about.hero_subtitle: Human expertise. Data intelligence. Total transparency.
about.manifesto_p1: There is something singular about the act of buying a home.
about.manifesto_p2_line1: It is not a transaction. It is a life decision.
about.manifesto_p2_line2: It is choosing where your children will grow up.
about.manifesto_p2_line3: It is defining the setting in which you'll wake up every morning.
about.manifesto_p2_line4: It is, often, the fruit of ten years of effort.
about.manifesto_p3: And yet — the Moroccan real estate market offers you two options: platforms that publish listings and leave you alone facing uncertainty, or traditional agencies that haven't evolved in twenty years.
about.manifesto_p5_line1: WeHome was born from a simple but radical conviction:
about.manifesto_p5_line2: real estate deserves to be treated with the rigour of a science
about.manifesto_p5_line3: and the sensitivity of an art.
about.manifesto_p6_part1: We put the asset at the centre.
about.section2_col1_desc: Mubawab, Yakeey — they publish. They index. They disappear. No support. No expertise. No accountability for the outcome.
about.section2_col2_desc: No data. No market transparency. Fees without justification. Follow-up that depends on the agent's mood.
about.section2_col3_desc: Expert agents, trained, accountable for results. Accessible and readable market data. Technology that serves the client — not one that replaces them.
about.pillar1_body: Our agents are not salespeople. They are real estate advisors — selected for their knowledge of the Casablanca market, trained to listen, evaluated on client satisfaction. Technology assists them. It never replaces them.
about.pillar2_body: We give you access to what you deserve to know: real market prices, neighborhood trends, average sale durations, comparables. You make your decisions with the right information — not with sales arguments.
about.pillar3_body: Our CRM, our platform, our data-driven marketing — these tools exist for one reason: to better serve the asset and the client. Not for show. Not to replace people. To give them the means to be excellent.
about.ecosystem_overline: An ecosystem built for the asset
about.eco1_body: Full support for the purchase, sale, and rental of your property. From the first contact to the handover of keys.
about.eco2_body: Offices, commercial spaces, long-term leases. For companies that understand their workspace is a strategic asset.
about.eco3_body: Enhance your property before bringing it to market. Interior architecture, home staging, photographic showcase.
about.team_intro_body: At WeHome, we believe an agency's quality is measured by the quality of the people who make it up. These are the people who carry that vision.
about.team_bio_karim: Leading strategy and operations, Karim drives WeHome's growth and ensures every transaction is as memorable as the property itself.
about.team_bio_basma: With an intimate knowledge of Casablanca's neighborhoods, Basma orchestrates WeHome's operations with surgical precision and ensures excellence in every client interaction.
about.team_bio_maha: Maha shapes WeHome's identity and voice across every channel. Her marketing vision combines data rigour and storytelling to position WeHome as Morocco's real estate reference.
about.team_bio_oumaima: Oumaima leads WeHome's financial strategy with uncompromising standards. She ensures the solidity of the business model and the transparency of flows at every stage of growth.
about.team_bio_abdou: Abdou architects the systems that power WeHome — CRM, platform, market data. His conviction: technology must be invisible to the client and devastatingly effective for the agent.
about.commitments_title: Six rules we will never break.
about.cta_subtitle: Whether you're buying, selling or investing — our agents are at your service.

estimer.hero_subtitle: Get an accurate estimate based on real Casablanca market transactions — by a WeHome agent who knows your neighborhood.
estimer.step3_title: Where should we send your estimate?
estimer.step3_subtitle: A WeHome agent who knows your neighborhood will contact you within 24h.
estimer.f_superficie_hint: Livable surface, excluding terrace and parking
estimer.consent_part1: I agree to be contacted by a WeHome agent regarding my estimate.
estimer.moti_rent: I want to rent, not sell
estimer.err_generic: An error occurred. Please retry or contact us directly.
estimer.success_body_part3: will contact you within the next 24 hours with a detailed estimate of your property.
estimer.success_body_part4: In the meantime, discover similar properties in your neighborhood.
estimer.why1_body: Unlike automatic estimators, your property is analyzed by an agent who knows your neighborhood, its real prices, and recent transactions — not just national averages.
estimer.why2_body: We access data on actual transactions completed in Casablanca — not asking prices. The difference can reach 15 to 20% depending on the neighborhood.
estimer.why3_body: Our estimate is free and without obligation. We believe trust is built before the signature, not after.
estimer.testimonial_1_quote: I had an estimate from another agency at 1.8M. WeHome explained why the market justified 2.1M — and they sold in 6 weeks.
estimer.testimonial_2_quote: First time I received a real written report with comparables. Not just a number out of thin air.
estimer.testimonial_3_quote: The agent knew every building on my street. That's real local expertise.
estimer.faq_1_a: Yes, without conditions or commitment. We believe the relationship starts with trust, not with a contract.
estimer.faq_2_q: How does WeHome calculate the value of my property?
estimer.faq_2_a: Our agent analyzes recent real transactions in your neighborhood, compares your property to similar sold properties, and accounts for the specifics of your home (floor, condition, view, features).
estimer.faq_3_a: You receive a detailed estimate. If you want to go further, we offer a listing mandate. Otherwise, we remain available when you're ready.
estimer.faq_4_q: How long does it take to sell a property with WeHome?
estimer.faq_4_a: On average, our properties find a buyer in 6 to 10 weeks when correctly priced. Price transparency is the #1 factor in sale speed.
estimer.closing_title_line1: Ready to know the real value

partenaires.hero_subtitle: WeHome invites the country's best agencies to join a shared platform — shared listings, common standards, national visibility. The Moroccan MLS is being built now.
partenaires.what1_body: Your properties exposed to WeHome's audience across Morocco — local buyers, national investors, the Moroccan diaspora abroad.
partenaires.what2_body: You keep your name, your logo, your contacts. WeHome amplifies your reach, not your identity. Your brand stays yours.
partenaires.what3_body: Verified, mandated, photographed properties. A network that protects quality — and therefore buyer trust in every member agency.
partenaires.waitlist_subtitle: The first partner agencies will benefit from preferential conditions and priority access at launch.
partenaires.err_generic: An error occurred. Please retry or contact us directly.
partenaires.disclaimer: No commitment. Preferential conditions reserved for the first registrants.
partenaires.success_title: Thank you {{name}}. You're on the list.
partenaires.success_body: We'll contact you in priority when the WeHome network launches. Welcome aboard.
partenaires.faq_1_a: Yes. WeHome does not take a commission on your transactions. The partner model is based on a monthly subscription — details will be communicated to waiting list members in priority.
partenaires.faq_2_q: Can my competitors see my listings?
partenaires.faq_2_a: Your listings are visible to buyers on the platform. Other agencies see available properties but not your client contacts. That's exactly the MLS model — transparency for the market, not for competitors.
partenaires.faq_3_q: In which cities will the network be available?
partenaires.faq_3_a: The launch starts in Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech and Tanger. National expansion follows partner demand.
partenaires.faq_4_a: We're targeting a network launch within the next 12 months. Waitlisted agencies will be informed first and benefit from preferential conditions.
